svg.aria-label: ZODIAC: a Zelda-style adventure. In Commit Village each dungeon is one of my repos: zodiac-67 is cleared, another is being built at 3 AM, a third is locked. In the sage's cave the lore is told: a hero named ZODIAC awoke inside a PC and imagines, experiments, builds, breaks, fixes and ships whatever catches their eye. In the treasure vault the hero gets Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, caffeine and bugs. Thanks for playing: star a repo to save your progress.
